title: 三衢道中
author: 曾几
intro: A cheerful travel snapshot from early summer: sunny days, a boat trip up a stream, then a walk through green mountain shade — where the only new thing is a few orioles singing.
analysis: 这是一首轻松愉快的纪行诗，写诗人在三衢山（今浙江衢州）路上的见闻。江南的“梅子黄时”本来应该是阴雨连绵的梅雨季，可是这几天“日日晴”，心情自然很好。他先坐小船沿着小溪走到尽头，再改走山路。山路两边绿树成荫，和来的时候一样浓密，没有减少；不同的是，多了几声黄鹂的叫声。“不减”和“添得”对比，写出初夏比春天更浓的绿意和生机。全诗像一篇小游记：时间、天气、路线、景色、声音都有，语言简单，读起来让人觉得清新明快。
analysisEn: This is a light, happy travel poem about a journey near Mount Sanqu (today’s Quzhou in Zhejiang). In the south, “when the plums turn yellow” is normally the rainy season, with gloomy drizzle for weeks — yet this year it is sunny day after day, and the poet’s spirits are high. He first takes a small boat up a stream until the water runs out, then continues on foot along a mountain path. The trees along the path give as much green shade as they did when he came this way before — none of it has thinned. The only difference is that now there are a few orioles singing. The contrast between “not less” (不减) and “added” (添得) captures the early summer: just as green as spring, but even more alive. The poem reads like a tiny travel diary — time, weather, route, scenery and sound all in four lines — in simple language that leaves you feeling fresh and bright.
background: Zeng Ji (1084–1166) was a Southern Song official and poet, remembered also as a teacher of the great poet Lu You. Sanqu refers to the area around Mount Sanqu in Quzhou, Zhejiang.
pronunciation: 衢 qú。却山行：却 què（再、又），行 xíng。黄鹂：鹂 lí。
version: 采用通行教材版本。维基文库所据本“小溪泛尽”作“小溪汛尽”，网站用教材的“泛尽”。

lines.py: méi zǐ huáng shí rì rì qíng
lines.lit: When the plums turn yellow, every day is clear;
lines.en: Plums turning yellow, and sunshine every day;

lines.py: xiǎo xī fàn jìn què shān xíng
lines.lit: boating the little stream to its end, then walking the mountain.
lines.en: I row up the stream till it ends, then take the mountain path.

lines.py: lǜ yīn bù jiǎn lái shí lù
lines.lit: The green shade is no less than on the road when I came;
lines.en: The green shade is as deep as when I came this way,

lines.py: tiān dé huáng lí sì wǔ shēng
lines.lit: added are four or five calls of the orioles.
lines.en: only now there are four or five orioles singing.

words.en: Sanqu — the area around Mount Sanqu, Quzhou
words.note: 衢州在今浙江西部。衢本义是四通八达的大路。

words.en: when the plums turn yellow (early summer)
words.note: 江南五六月，本来是多雨的“梅雨季节”。

words.en: to float; to go by boat
words.note: 古义；现代汉语“泛舟”仍是书面语。
古义，和今天表示转折的“却”（but）不同。
一种黄色的鸣禽，叫声好听，如杜甫“两个黄鹂鸣翠柳”。

imagery.name: 水
imagery.zh: 小溪是旅程的第一段，坐船走到溪水尽头，写出一路的轻快。
imagery.en: The stream is the first leg of the trip; boating to its end gives the journey an easy, light feel.

imagery.name: 路
imagery.zh: “来时路”让人想起来时的春景，回程的山路绿意依旧。
imagery.en: “The road I came by” recalls the spring trip out; the mountain path back is just as green.

imagery.name: 鸟
imagery.zh: 几声黄鹂鸣叫，是回程新添的惊喜，让幽静的山路有了生气。
imagery.en: A few oriole calls are the new delight on the way back, bringing the quiet mountain path to life.
